A '''sealant patch'''<ref name="OBF" /> or '''suit patch'''<ref name="GG1-2" /> was a small patch used to seal a hole or tear in a [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] or other article.<ref name="OBF" />

[[Maris Ferasi]] and [[Jorj Car'das]] attempted to use one when [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] was injured and had a hole torn in his vacc suit during the [[Battle of Geroon|Battle of the Geroon homeworld]]. It would not bond correctly to the material and Maris had to stop the air from leaking out of his suit by pushing her chest against his until two [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] arrived with a larger patch.<ref name="OBF" />

[[Docking Bay 99]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] stocked patches that were available from vending machines for a small number of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="GG1-2" />
